about: Yellowknife is the capital of the Northwest Territories, on the northern shore of Great Slave Lake on the Canadian Shield. Government, mining heritage, and northern research shape a compact city of old town rock outcrops, Frame Lake trails, and a modern downtown. It is the territories’ main air hub and service centre. About 20,000 people live in Yellowknife.
